messages:
alex.m: FYI opened PR #4523 to add prod/staging overlays for svc-auth. Main change is moving secret paths into overlays and adding kustomize patches. can someone do a quick sanity-check on the release gating config?

jordan: link? :eyes:

alex.m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523

sam.k: quick skim — terraform changes touch aws_ssm_parameter "svc-auth/db_password_path". Are we migrating SSM -> Secrets Manager here?

priya.r: yes, plan is SSM -> Secrets Manager for prod. TF snippet: 
```
resource \"aws_secretsmanager_secret\" \"svc_auth_db\" {
  name = \"/redwood/prod/svc-auth/db\"
}
```
we'll add a short migration step in the ops runbook (staging first).

li: one ask: ensure KMS key alias is set per-account. If the secret ARN changes we need to update the redwood-secret-sync lambda IAM permissions.

sam.k: CI is currently failing on the kustomize overlay: kustomization.yaml references a secretGenerator with `literals:` which we shouldn't commit. Need to switch to referencing `secretRef` to external secret.

alex.m: ok i'll update. also question about gating: currently release-configs has a hard gate for `prod-overlay-change` job. Can we allow an automatic canary if it's overlay-only (no TF or IAM changes)?

jordan: ops prefers manual approval when overlays touch secrets. For pure config-only overlays we can enable an automated canary (10% traffic for 30m) but only if there are no secret path diffs.

priya.r: proposed gating patch snippet: 
```
- name: overlay-canary
  type: canary
  params:
    percent: 10
    duration: 30m
    require_approval_on_secrets: true
```
This will auto-run a canary unless `require_approval_on_secrets` is triggered by an overlay referencing `secretRef`.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary svc-auth v2026.03-canary (10% traffic)

alex.m: thanks. @sam.k can you re-run terraform plan after i push the generator change?

sam.k: on it. rerunning now. plan looks clean except for missing IAM for secret-sync lambda. opened a small PR to add `iam:secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` for that role.

li: once PRs are green i'll run the migration in staging and run the canary. Planning to do prod migration during the 09:00 PST on-call window — who can cover?

jordan: 09:00 PST works for infra on-call. @priya.r can you notify support?

priya.r: noted, i'll post the ops runbook and migration steps to #support and tag on-call.

alex.m: LGTM — will merge when CI is green. :shipit:

sam.k: CI green. merging now.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded, promoting to prod-initial. :tada:

alex.m: merging prod overlay now. final check: ensure rotation TTL is set to 365d in secret metadata.

li: added `rotation_days: 365` to the overlay secrets and updated the secret-sync policy.

alex.m: thanks everyone, closing this thread.
